community.title: Thanks for downloading and building Glyph yourself.
community.body: Support the project with the official license to get automatic updates and the official build.

earlyAccess.title: Help shape Glyph
earlyAccess.body: Glyph is actively evolving and changing, so you may run into rough edges here and there. If something feels off, I'd really love to hear about it.

language.title: Language
language.label: App language
language.description: Choose the language used by Glyph's interface.
language.systemDescription: Uses your operating system language when Glyph supports it, otherwise English.

shortcuts.title: Customize Shortcuts
shortcuts.help: Click a shortcut, then press the keys you want to use. Shortcuts save automatically and need Cmd, Ctrl, or Option plus another key.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Mix and match light and dark theme families.
theme.pickPaletteLight: Pick the palette Glyph uses in light mode.
theme.pickPaletteDark: Pick the palette Glyph uses in dark mode.

accent.title: Accent
accent.paletteDescription: Preview and select the accent that feels best for your workspace.
accent.descriptionBoth: Choose the accent used for highlights, focus rings, and emphasis in the default light and dark themes.
accent.descriptionLight: Choose the accent used for highlights, focus rings, and emphasis in the default light theme.
accent.descriptionDark: Choose the accent used for highlights, focus rings, and emphasis in the default dark theme.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Tune interface type, code styling, and reading scale independently.
typography.interfaceFontDescription: Used for navigation, settings, and most UI copy across Glyph.
typography.editorFontDescription: Used for regular note text outside inline code and code blocks.
typography.monospaceFontDescription: Used for markdown source, inline code, and developer-oriented surfaces.
typography.uiFontSizeDescription: Adjust the base size used by menus, panes, controls, and settings.
typography.editorFontSizeDescription: Adjust the reading size for the note editor, markdown preview, and raw text editing.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Controls for editing behavior and note structure inside Glyph.
editor.tableOfContentsDescription: Show a floating table of contents for each note.
editor.peopleMentionsAsTagsDescription: When enabled, standalone @mentions are indexed and shown as people in the sidebar and search.
editor.showFrontmatterDescription: Display YAML frontmatter at the top of notes while editing. Turning this off keeps frontmatter available to indexing and databases.
editor.colorfulHeadingsDescription: Use distinct built-in colors for H1-H6 while editing notes.
editor.beautifulTagsDescription: Enable the experimental Beautiful Tags presentation for tags.
editor.editorWidthDescription: Compact keeps lines shorter, Comfortable gives a little bit more room, and Wide uses the full editor width.
editor.collapsibleHeadingsDescription: Show collapse toggles on note headings in editor and preview.
editor.vimModeDescription: Do NOT Turn this ON if you don't know what it means.

vimHelp.title: Vim keybindings
vimHelp.insertMode: insert means normal typing mode. You type and text appears, like the editor already does.
vimHelp.normalMode: normal means command mode. Your keys move around or edit text instead of typing letters.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Controls for how the AI assistant behaves by default.
ai.toolsAccess: AI chat has access to tools
ai.toolsAccessDescription: When on, AI can use tools to create and take actions. When off, it stays in chat-only mode.

app.title: App
app.description: Global app-level controls for the sidebar and workspace UI.
app.folioModeDescription: Show navigation, notes, and editor in a three-column workspace.
app.classicAllNotesDescription: Open All Notes as the simple grid instead of the activity timeline.
app.folderFileCountsDescription: Show a recursive file total at the end of each folder row in the file tree.

database.title: Database
database.description: Global controls for how databases are presented across Glyph.
database.columnColorDescription: Keep the lane pill and tag colors while toggling the full column tint.

updates.title: Updates
updates.checkingLicense: Checking whether this build can use automatic updates.
updates.licenseUnknown: Glyph could not determine whether this build can use automatic updates.
updates.canAutoUpdate: Check for new releases and install them without leaving Glyph.
updates.licenseStatusDescription: Glyph could not verify the current license state in this window, so update actions are unavailable right now.
updates.appUpdatesDescription: Checks immediately and downloads the latest published version in the background. Installation only happens when you choose it.
updates.alphaReleasesDescription: Get early access to alpha builds. These may be unstable, so only turn this on if you're comfortable testing unfinished releases.
updates.communityBuildDescription: You're using the Community and Open Source version of Glyph. Purchase an official license to support Glyph's development and receive the latest updates automatically.
updates.statusDescription: Latest updater activity from this window.
updates.latestVersion: You're already on the latest version.
updates.updateReady: v{{version}} is downloaded and ready. Click the update button to install it.
updates.changelogDescription: Open the published Glyph changelog in your browser.

dailyNotes.title: Daily Notes
dailyNotes.description: Choose where new daily notes should be created within the current space.
dailyNotes.folderDescription: Glyph stores daily notes relative to the active space.

quickNotes.title: Quick Notes
quickNotes.folderDescription: New quick notes are added to today's note in this folder.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Choose where note attachments are stored within the current space.
attachments.locationDescription: Where to save images and files you paste into notes.
attachments.helpSpaceRoot: Saved at the top level of your space.
attachments.helpNoteFolder: Saved next to the note they are attached to.
attachments.helpSpecificFolder: All attachments go in one folder.

searchIndex.title: Search Index
searchIndex.description: Rebuild the index if search results are incomplete, stale, or missing.
searchIndex.statusDescription: Use this when search results look outdated after large note or file changes.
searchIndex.openSpaceFirst: Open a space first to rebuild the index.

errors.folderInsideSpace: Selected folder must be inside the current space.
errors.selectQuickNotesFolder: Failed to select quick notes folder
errors.resetQuickNotesFolder: Failed to reset quick notes folder

templates.title: Templates
templates.templateFolderDescription: Choose a folder inside the current space that contains your markdown templates.

errors.clearDailyTemplate: Failed to clear daily note template
errors.updateDailyTemplate: Failed to update daily note template

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Glyph uses Git automatically when the opened space is already a repository.
connection.availabilityDescription: Glyph uses the system git binary and your existing Git credentials.
connection.repoStateDescription: Glyph only supports repositories rooted exactly at the current space.
connection.openGitFolder: Open a folder that already has Git initialized.
connection.branchDescription: Glyph syncs a single branch per space.

connectionHelp.installGit: Install Git to use Git Sync in repo-backed spaces.
connectionHelp.nestedRepo: This space is inside a larger Git repository. Glyph only supports repos rooted exactly at the opened space.
connectionHelp.configured: Glyph automatically uses the Git repository found at this space root.
connectionHelp.needsRemote: Glyph found a repository here, but it still needs an origin remote before sync can start.
connectionHelp.default: Git Sync becomes available automatically when the opened space already contains a .git repository at its root.

sync.title: Sync
sync.description: Control automatic syncs and trigger a manual sync at any time.
sync.automaticDescription: Runs on space open and then on the selected interval.
sync.intervalDescription: How often Glyph should run scheduled syncs.
sync.actionsDescription: Run a sync from settings and review the latest sync state here.

conflicts.title: Conflict Resolution
conflicts.description: Choose which side Glyph should favor when local and remote edits conflict.

content.title: Content
content.description: Choose which space content Glyph should include in sync commits.
content.includeTemplatesDescription: Sync the current templates folder and its contents.
content.includeAttachmentsSpecific: Sync files from the configured attachments folder.
content.includeAttachmentsOther: Attachment-only filtering works only when attachments use Specific folder. In other modes, attachment files follow the broader non-markdown files setting.
content.includeNonMarkdownDescription: When off, Glyph limits sync to markdown plus explicitly included folders.

presentation.openRepoSpace: Open a repo-backed space to sync this workspace.
presentation.installGitCopy: Glyph uses your system Git install and existing credentials.
presentation.unsupportedHeadline: This space sits inside another repo
presentation.unsupportedCopy: Glyph only supports repositories rooted exactly at the opened space.
presentation.syncingCopy: Glyph is running Git in the background. You can keep working while it finishes.
presentation.pausedCopy: Manual sync still works, and you can resume automatic runs when you're ready.
presentation.attentionCopy: Glyph found something that needs to be resolved before the next safe sync.
presentation.readyCopy: This space is connected and ready to back up changes.
presentation.manualCopy: Automatic sync is off. Trigger a sync whenever you want to save a snapshot.
presentation.repoFoundHeadline: Repository detected, but not ready to sync
presentation.repoFoundCopy: Add an origin remote to this repo and Glyph will start tracking it automatically.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Turn AI tools on or off across Glyph.
availability.featuresDescription: When off, AI panels and AI command-palette actions stay hidden.
availability.configurationDescription: Turn AI back on to manage providers, models, and account access.
availability.hiddenUntilEnabled: AI configuration stays hidden until AI features are enabled.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Choose the service, model, and advanced connection fields. Provider changes switch to that provider's saved setup; other edits save automatically.
provider.modelDescription: Glyph fetches available models for the selected provider when credentials allow it.
provider.reasoningLevelDescription: Available when the current model exposes effort levels.
provider.reasoningManualHint: This model did not publish reasoning options; enter effort manually.
provider.baseUrlLlama: Default is http://localhost:8080/v1 for a local llama.cpp server.
provider.baseUrlCompat: Only needed for custom OpenAI-compatible providers.
provider.allowLocalNetworkLlama: Enable to use localhost or private-network llama.cpp endpoints.
provider.allowLocalNetworkCompat: Enable to use http:// endpoints on localhost or private networks (e.g. LM Studio, vLLM).

modelCombobox.saveApiKeyHint: Save an API key to load models for this provider.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Stored locally in the secure secret store used by Glyph.
apiKey.keyDescription: Paste a provider key, save it locally, or clear the current stored secret.

codex.title: ChatGPT Account
codex.description: Check connection status, sign in, and review Codex usage limits.
codex.identityDescription: The connected account Glyph is currently using for Codex.
codex.authenticationDescription: How this ChatGPT session is currently authenticated.
codex.rateLimitsDescription: These counters show the remaining capacity for the connected account.
